name: 3D Led Moon Night Light lamps for Kids Gifts for Women, USB & Touch Control & Dimmable Moon Lamp with Stand, Creative Home Decoration
description:
3D Print Moon Lamp – Night Light 🌙

Specifications:

Type: Atmosphere Light / Night Light

Shape: Moon

Bulbs Included: Yes

Model Number: 3D Print Moon Lamp

Battery Included: Yes (Built-in Lithium-ion 240mAh Li-Po)

Body Material: Plastic

Battery Type: Lithium-ion

Light Source: LED Bulbs (1 white LED + 1 yellow LED)

Power Generation: Touch Control

Voltage: DC 5V

Power Source: Rechargeable Battery

Battery Required: No

Usage: Holiday / Home Decoration

Wattage: 0.5W (max 5W)

Brightness: Stepless adjustment

Color Temperature: 3000K / 6000K

Charging Time: 6–8 hours

Working Time: 8–30 hours (depending on brightness)

Power Supply: USB DC 5V

Features:

Adjustable Brightness & Color: Switch between warm yellow and cool white light to create the perfect ambiance.

Rechargeable & Portable: Built-in battery allows wireless use for hours after a full charge.

Touch Control: Easy to operate with a simple tap to change brightness or color.

Perfect Gift: Ideal for holidays, bedrooms, kids’ rooms, or as a decorative night light.
